web_title: Magnesium Bisglycinate 200 mg – Vegan, Gluten Free, Non-GMO (NPN 80098765)
web_description_html:
Meet your new evening ritual: Magnesium Bisglycinate 200 mg (NPN 80098765). Each vegetable capsule delivers 200 mg of chelated magnesium bisglycinate, chosen for tolerability and easy absorption.

  • Helps to maintain proper muscle function, including the heart muscle.
  • Helps in the development and maintenance of bones and teeth.
  • Helps to prevent magnesium deficiency.
  • Helps in energy metabolism and in tissue formation.

Brand notes: Vegan, gluten free, non-GMO.
Serving: 1 capsule, 1 to 2 times daily.
Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Some people may experience diarrhoea.
